scheme_name: Swami Vivekananda Nishakta Swavlamban Protsahan Yojana
other_conditions: Applicant must belong to the disability categories defined under the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016 (Section‑2(r), (s), (t), (zc))
Applicant must not be a beneficiary under any other Social Security pension scheme
Applicant must not be retired or permanently employed in Central or State Government or public sector undertakings
Applicant or spouse must not be receiving any family pension or pension from Central/State Government or public sector undertakings
Applicant’s family must not be an income‑tax payee
Applicant should have a Voter ID card and, if aged 18 years or above, an Aadhar Card
benefits_summary: ₹1,000 per month transferred directly to the beneficiary’s bank account.
documents_required: Aadhar Card (for applicants aged 18 years and above)
